editorialSummary: Nothing says peak efficiency quite like [Meta trying to scapegoat staff](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/10/meta-ordered-to-name-execs-who-approved-torrenting-for-ai-training/) while [European gas prices spike](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-20/european-gas-prices-rise-above-90-for-first-time-since-2022) and [Elon Musk slows Starlink](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/russia-central-asia/article/3371563/musk-ordered-slowdown-starlink-service-ukraine-military-relies-report-says). At least [Chinese researchers discovering neurons act as minicomputers](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/science/article/3371538/chinese-scientists-find-neurons-may-act-minicomputers-help-decision-making) proves something in this universe is still processing logic.
